text: Umbro is one of the brands of Iconix Brand Group, Inc., an American brand-management company; Iconix acquired the Umbro brand from Nike for $225 million in 2012 and still licenses it (as Iconix International) in 2025. Since 4 August 2021 Iconix has been a wholly-owned subsidiary of Iconix Acquisition LLC, which Avram Glazer and the Avram Glazer Irrevocable Exempt Trust control.
short: Umbro is an Iconix Brand Group brand; Iconix has been controlled by Avram Glazer and his trust since 2021.
